name: Lime
source:
An elementary school student who often shows up in the plaza in front of Kyobashi Station. He's reserved. cautious, and shy, but once he determines that someone is kind, he quickly opens up to them, showing some of the trusting naivety you'd expect from a kid of his age. He seems to be waiting for his mom to come pick him up after school.
[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943040]Steam[/url]]
